params.name: q
params.description: A list of terms to be searched. If multiple terms are supplied, matches will only be returned for items that contain all terms. Terms may include an `*` at the end to indicate a wildcard. A term may be negated to indicate that it should *not* be present in the results (e.g., `cat -fish`). Use quotation marks to search for an exact phrase.

params.name: subject
params.description: Search for a dataset by subject keyword.

params.name: orcid
params.description: Search for authors using author [ORCIDs](https://orcid.org/). If multiple, separate with a space.

params.name: author
params.description: Search for authors by name.

params.name: affiliation
params.description: A ROR identifier for an institutional affiliation that must be present in the list of dataset authors. The identifier should be in the full "https" format and should be URL-encoded, e.g., `https%3A%2F%2Fror.org%2F00x6h5n95`.

params.name: facility
params.description: A ROR identifier for the dataset research facility. The identifier should be in the full "https" format and should be URL-encoded, e.g., `https%3A%2F%2Fror.org%2F00x6h5n95`.

params.name: funder
params.description: A ROR identifier for a dataset funder. The identifier should be in the full "https" format and should be URL-encoded, e.g., `https%3A%2F%2Fror.org%2F00x6h5n95`.

params.name: org
params.description: A ROR identifier for a dataset funder, affiliation, or research facility. The identifier should be in the full "https" format and should be URL-encoded, e.g., `https%3A%2F%2Fror.org%2F00x6h5n95`.

params.name: tenant
params.description: The abbreviation for a partner organization in Dryad. This will automatically search all organizations associated with the given tenant.

params.name: award
params.description: An award or grant number associated with the dataset.

params.name: journalISSN
params.description: The journal ISSN.

params.name: relatedId
params.description: Any related work ID associated with the dataset, including manuscript numbers and PubMed IDs.

params.name: publishedSince
params.description: A date or timestamp for limiting results. Datasets will only be returned that have been published since the given date/time. The date must be specified in ISO 8601 format (`2020-10-08`). If including a time, the time must be specified in ISO 8601 format, and the time zone must be set to UTC, e.g., `2020-10-08T10:24:53Z`.

params.name: publishedBefore
params.description: A date or timestamp for limiting results. Datasets will only be returned that have been published before the given date/time. The date must be specified in ISO 8601 format (`2020-10-08`). If including a time, the time must be specified in ISO 8601 format, and the time zone must be set to UTC, e.g., `2020-10-08T10:24:53Z`.

params.name: relatedWorkIdentifier
params.description: A DOI or other URL that links a dataset to a related work. It allows `*` as a wildcard at the beginning and/or end of the value.

params.name: relatedWorkRelationship
params.description: The type of relationship expressed by a related work.

params.name: modifiedSince
params.description: A date or timestamp for limiting results. Datasets will only be returned that have been modified since the given date/time. The date must be specified in ISO 8601 format (`2020-10-08`). If including a time, the time must be specified in ISO 8601 format, and the time zone must be set to UTC, e.g., `2020-10-08T10:24:53Z`.

params.name: modifiedBefore
params.description: A date or timestamp for limiting results. Datasets will only be returned that have been modified before the given date/time. The date must be specified in ISO 8601 format (`2020-10-08`). If including a time, the time must be specified in ISO 8601 format, and the time zone must be set to UTC, e.g., `2020-10-08T10:24:53Z`.

params.name: page
params.description: Which page of results to view. Defaults to page 1.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Number of results to return on each page. Defaults to 20. Maximum allowed is 100.

items.docs: Search the published Dryad datasets. Query all fields, or look for terms in specific metadata fields of the dataset.
